text:
About 2.23% of the property was affected. Hansen/UMD mapped roughly 81.3 ha of tree-cover loss in 2021 within the 3,643.5 ha asset. The evidence supports this finding: later years were observed, and the JRC 2020 forest reference agrees on 98% of the affected area.

Most of the loss (68.1 ha) was in planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda). None was in native forest, and 13.2 ha fell outside mapped forest. A further 37.3 ha of loss occurred in patches under 0.5 ha. These are not counted in the 81.3 ha.

Limits: tree-cover loss includes any stand replacement, such as plantation harvest. This evidence does not show whether deforestation or land-use change occurred. It also does not show the cause, legality or responsible party, and it supports no compliance conclusion (for example, EUDR).
